offers_products.reason: Sells gaming content, Virtual Sports software, server-based systems and gaming machine hardware to operators.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from licensed content, software and leased terminals, not from work done for customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are licensed gaming, betting and lottery operators; players only use the games through those operators.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to betting shop, pub, gaming hall, route, iGaming and lottery operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Operators keep paying for games and leased terminals, mostly under ongoing recurring or revenue-share arrangements.

cyclical_demand.reason: Revenue depends on discretionary player spending on gaming and betting, and operators can delay hardware upgrades.

big_ticket.reason: Games and content are licensed on recurring, small-increment terms; terminals are leased rather than sold in one large sale.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for games, software, technology and machines, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large licensed betting, gaming and lottery operators.

asset_heavy.reason: Retail business needs ongoing investment in leased gaming machines and terminals placed with operators.

notes: Asset-heavy and cyclical are judgement calls. The website text doesn't give the revenue mix between leased machines and digital content.
